description.value:
Vines magically sprout from any solid surface within 30 feet of you and weave around your torso, leaving your arms and legs free. The vines extend and retract as you move, always anchoring to the nearest surface. If a vine is destroyed, it's immediately replaced. For the duration, you gain a fly Speed of 40 feet, provided you remain within 30 feet of a solid surface. If you move farther than 30 feet from any solid surface, this fly Speed ends immediately and you fall normally. You cannot be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]{Prone}, and you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against effects that would force you to move against your will (such as a shove, bull rush, or gust of wind). If you are falling when you cast this spell (using a reaction), the vines catch you, negating all falling damage.

Heightened (5th) The required proximity to a surface extends to 60 feet, and the fly Speed increases to 60 feet.
